''See also: [[Gardeners Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Gardeners are a highly respected and secretive order of assassins within the [[Imperial]] [[Guild]], specifically serving as part of the [[Council of Architects]]. While their existence is officially denied to those outside the [[Island]], they function as a specialized group tasked with maintaining balance within [[The Empire|the Empire]] by removing problematic individuals, metaphorically described as pruning weeds. This role allows citizens to resolve conflicts through an [[Imperial]] [[Guild]] rather than through private warfare. The Gardeners are part of a larger hierarchy: [[Architects]] design plans, [[Masons]] build foundations, and Shepherds handle observation. Unlike many [[Readers]] who are moved into administrative or strategic roles to avoid danger, Gardeners accept perilous assignments. They are known for their extreme skill and confidence, often operating with a level of stealth that makes them difficult to detect. Upon induction into the [[Consultants]], each [[Gardener]] is issued a pair of [[shears]], which are actually ancient bronze daggers. These weapons are imbued with significant [[Intent]], allowing them to easily bypass armor and bone to deliver fatal wounds. The order is led by a [[High Gardener]], such as [[Kerian]], and members typically retire or transition to other [[Architect]] roles by age fifty. While most Gardeners are trained through standard procedures, some may receive specialized instruction based on [[Imperial]] commands.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Gardeners are a secretive group or discipline that the public is led to believe does not exist. Originally, this order provided strategic advice concerning the [[Soulbound]] and worked in secret for the majority of [[Meia]]'s life to spread [[Nakothi]]'s influence. Though [[Lucan]] studied this discipline, the members are trained to avoid armed conflict, using [[shears]] that cannot hold their own against a sword. Currently, there are three Gardeners traveling with the Emperor, yet the group maintains enough power that they could be sent to depopulate [[The Testament]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Gardeners are a sparsely populated guild within [[The Empire|the Empire]], recognizable by their standard-issue black clothing known as [[Gardener blacks]]. Functioning as a squad within the [[Guild]], members such as [[Meia]] and [[Shera]] follow commands from an unnamed leader and perform pruning work determined by the [[Council]]. The group, which includes individuals like [[Ayana]] who served as an instructor, undergoes training provided by the Emperor. While their primary duty involves removing weeds, the group's status is significant enough to be used in comparisons regarding value, and even imitation members have been subject to inspection by the [[Readers]].}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Gardeners are an order of [[Consultants]] distinguished by their use of skintight black silks. Within this guild, which some [[Consultants]] hold opinions about, the fifteen most senior members are awarded true [[shears|Gardener shears]], of which only fifteen sets remain in existence. While [[Shera]] maintains an association with the group and has even utilized imitation members, she does not trust their plans as much as others. During various events, the Gardeners have attempted to assassinate certain [[Champions]] and infiltrated crowds alongside [[Shera]] and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]]. Ultimately, [[Shera]] has sent members to spread throughout the city and has called upon them, noting that some carry glowing [[shears]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Only fifteen sets of true [[shears|Gardener shears]] remain in the [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The fifteen most senior [[Gardeners]] are awarded [[shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
